home.sub: Aqary is the third option between carrying installments you can no longer afford and cancelling with a 10–15% deduction. Transfer your contract to a verified buyer, with no overprice, and receive what you have paid in cash.

home.marketTitle: A liquidity problem inside a multi-trillion-pound market.
home.marketSub: Roughly 99% of Egyptian property is bought off-plan because mortgage finance is about 0.3% of GDP. The developer's installment plan is the financing.
home.marketStat2: mortgage finance as a share of GDP
home.marketCaveat: The 500,000-contract and EGP 3 trillion figures are our own estimates, not official government statistics. Methodology: ~100,000 annual primary transactions across an assumed ~8-year average payment period, cross-checked against ~EGP 3.2 trillion in developer sales during 2024–2025.

faq.q1: Why would a seller sell without a profit?
faq.a1: Because the alternative is worse. Returning the unit to the developer typically deducts 10–15% of the full unit price and refunds the remainder over years. Transferring without overprice returns all of what they paid, in cash, on completion.
faq.a2: The unit at an older contract price, below the developer's price today, continuing the normal installments. That price difference is their gain from the day they sign, without paying an overprice to anyone.
faq.q3: How do I know the numbers are real?
faq.a3: Before an opportunity appears, the contract and payment receipts are read, reconciled and confirmed by a human analyst. Every figure displayed carries a marker showing whether it is confirmed by documents or still estimated.
faq.q4: What if I have overdue installments?
faq.a4: They are calculated within the assessment, and the deal terms state who settles them — usually the buyer, as part of what is required from them. Acting early, before default procedures escalate, matters.
faq.a5: No. Aqary deals directly with the unit owner and directly with the end buyer. Signing and official dealings with the developer happen in your own name, with your attendance; Aqary prepares the file and follows the process through.
